title: Bounded influential neighbor probability
statement: Let $q$ be a positive integer and let $G$ be a regular unique game over $q$ symbols. Let the table assign to each vertex a function from the Boolean cube $\\{−1,1\\}^{q}$ to $[-1,1]$. For a real parameter $\\varepsilon$, a vertex $v$, and a coordinate $i\\in\\{0,\\ldots,q-1\\}$, the bounded influential neighbor probability is the expectation over neighbors $w$ of $v$ of the indicator that the coordinate obtained by applying the inverse edge permutation to $i$ is a bounded influential coordinate at $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with alphabet size $q$
A table of functions on the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube taking values in $[-1,1]$
